decisions.reason: The source reiterates high-quality mixing and consistent foam as reasons for choosing smaller bowls, but does not change those existing performance outcomes.
The bowl-capacity decision does not change the existing green accent requirement or establish a different color scheme.
Smaller bowls may help satisfy the existing enclosure-size constraint, but the source does not change the required enclosure form factor.
The source changes bowl capacity and associated priorities but does not alter the existing splash-control target.
The bowl-size decision has no effect on the machine placard text.
Changing bowl capacity does not necessarily change the spout's bottom mounting, barista-facing orientation, or pouring access.
The leak-free seal requirements remain valid unchanged regardless of the newly selected smaller bowl capacity.
The smaller-bowl decision does not alter the requirement to prevent liquid from reaching the base or electronics.
The source does not change the dispensing path's removability or cleaning method.
The selected bowl capacity does not change the required valve behavior, drip prevention, or controlled flow rate.
The bowl-size decision does not modify the prototype's standard 120V wall-power requirement.
The CAD may need to embody the smaller-bowl requirement, but the source does not change the existence or format of the system-layout and CAD deliverable.
